day_shape: Trump announces US ship escorts through Strait of Hormuz from Monday, drawing Iranian warnings of ceasefire violation; CENTCOM transfers Tusca crew to Pakistan, IDF reports two Hezbollah killed in south Lebanon, heavy Khamenei/IRIB messaging cycle.

threads.label: US Hormuz escort plan and Iranian response
threads.summary: Trump announced via Truth Social that the US would begin guiding commercial vessels through the Strait of Hormuz from Monday, which Iranian officials and parliamentarians called a ceasefire violation. CENTCOM commander Adm. Brad Cooper visited USS Milius supporting blockade operations, while IRGC's Brig. Gen. Abdollahi and analyst Mohammad Marandi said Iran's armed forces control passage; UKMTO reported an incident 78nm north of Fujairah.

threads.label: Tusca vessel crew repatriation
threads.summary: CENTCOM announced the transfer of 22 crew members from the impounded Iranian vessel Tusca to Pakistan for return to Iran, per ABC News reporting cited by IRIB and Defa Press. Regime channels described the move as a prelude to resolving the ship's ownership status.

threads.label: South Lebanon strikes and Hezbollah
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed two armed Hezbollah operatives south of the Forward Defense Line and struck a vehicle transporting weapons, also reporting weapons caches discovered. A Hezbollah MP vowed to thwart Lebanon-Israel talks; Defa Press claimed 11 Hezbollah drone, missile and artillery operations including suicide drone strikes near al-Naqoura.

threads.label: Iran executions and internal dissent
threads.summary: Iran's judiciary outlet Mizan reported the execution of Mehrab Abdollahzadeh, convicted over the killing of a security volunteer during 2022 protests, per Iran International and Israeli press. Iran International also reported clerical divisions over war escalation, while Defa Press said two men were executed in Mashhad over a December 1404 incident.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging and 64th-night gatherings
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted statements on teachers' influence, the 'Hope Sapling' campaign and quotations on mutual sympathy following the war, alongside remarks calling US Persian Gulf bases the chief source of regional insecurity. IRIB ran multiple posts on '64th night' public gatherings in Qods, Pakdasht, Pounak Square and Islam Shahr.

threads.label: Iran war economy and domestic strain
threads.summary: First Vice President Aref ordered action against profiteers after products saw 100% price rises in under a week, per IRIB, while a parliamentary deputy called internet shutdowns ineffective. Jerusalem Post reported severe shortages crippling Iran's healthcare system; WFP said 33,500 refugees in Iran received food and cash assistance.

threads.label: Trump war policy and diplomatic track
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported Trump rejected an Iran plan that would have ended the war within a month and deferred the nuclear issue. Defa Press cited Democratic Rep. Brandon Boyle calling the war 'unnecessary and reckless', and quoted China's foreign ministry spokesperson saying Beijing will not comply with US sanctions on Iranian oil.
